beats.what_happened: dhaniram seats birju in the munshi's chair, defers the promised appointment letter without a date, hands him a ledger blank from page one, and orders him to read every household's carry-forward aloud to the yard.

state_changes.fact: is the named keeper of the book and reads it in public
the appointment letter is deferred with no date given
is read aloud to the hamlet for the first time

beats.what_happened: birju reads sanichari's carry-forward as 63,200 against an original 4,800 taken twenty-two years earlier; she asks aloud for the release paper she says she was promised in that yard and devlal answers that no such paper is in the book.

state_changes.fact: her figure is now public in the hamlet
has asked for a release paper in front of witnesses and been refused

beats.note: dramatises the neighbouring family's sub-5,000 debt grown to 63,000 over two decades. The release paper is sanichari's spoken claim only.

beats.what_happened: birju reads a 10,000 fine standing against a household and devlal states in front of the yard that it was levied because a hen walked over drying bricks; lakhan demands to be paid once in cash in the open and dhaniram refuses him by listing what he has never refused.

state_changes.fact: asked for cash in public and was refused in public
has stated the fine schedule aloud in front of the hamlet

beats.note: t8 is tagged alleged. The fine is spoken by devlal inside the scene and is never narrated; this beat records that he asserted it, not that it is true.

beats.what_happened: sudama arrives at the edge of the yard and reports that on the seventeenth a magistrate and two buses took 137 people — 40 men, 46 women, 51 children — out of a kiln at chandwa; dhaniram tells the yard that chandwa is four hours away and orders the reading to continue.

state_changes.fact: knows that a kiln four hours away was emptied by an officer eight days ago
has a reason to want every household totalled in writing quickly

beats.note: t7 is reported, so the counts stand; the FIR is not mentioned and no operator or accountant is named.

beats.what_happened: dhaniram orders birju to call his own house; birju reads 89,400 against phulwa's household and finds his mother's thumbprint on the line above the figure, dated nine years before he learned to write.

state_changes.fact: his household's debt is public and he read it out himself
her thumbprint on the earlier line is now known to her son

beats.note: dramatises the advance taken by one household head, worked off by the whole household and transferred between generations.

beats.location: the ration shop at the crossing
beats.what_happened: birju asks phulwa in the queue what paper she put her thumb on; she answers only that it was a paper and asks whether he has eaten.

state_changes.fact: has refused her son a direct answer about the thumbprint
has not eaten in two days

beats.location: the ration shop at the crossing
beats.what_happened: sanichari tells birju that nobody who put a thumb on a paper was ever told which paper it was, that he is now the only one in the hamlet who knows what is in the book, and asks him what he will do with knowing.

state_changes.fact: is named by a worker as the only literate party to the book
has put a demand on birju without naming it a demand

beats.location: the ration shop at the crossing
beats.what_happened: devlal issues rations against the same ledger the kiln accounts are kept in; sudama pays 500 rupees cash for five kilo of flour rather than be entered, and devlal tells him his mother's house stands at 19,600.

state_changes.fact: learns the ration shop and the kiln are kept in one book
his mother's household figure is now public at the crossing

beats.location: the ration shop at the crossing
beats.what_happened: chameli tells birju that her father refused the marriage the previous night and that the figure reached their side of the fields within two days without anyone from the kiln carrying it.

state_changes.fact: has come to the crossing against her father to warn birju
learns the figure has travelled outside bharwara

beats.location: the crossing, outside the ration shop
beats.what_happened: chameli's father calls the marriage off in the queue in front of everyone, is made by birju to state the figure, gives it as 89,400 exactly, and says that nobody at the kiln told him anything.

state_changes.fact: engagement broken in public at the crossing
her marriage is publicly cancelled over a number in a book
is known outside bharwara by a route nobody can account for

beats.note: chameli's father speaks as an unnamed walk-on and carries no char_id, so he appears in no array here.

beats.what_happened: a page numbered 411 was torn out of the earlier volume before that volume was shut in the office almirah.

state_changes.fact: is incomplete and its absence is unrecorded

beats.note: Deliberate open canon: nobody witnesses this and no character can be asked about it. tirath is the only name not in hidden_from because he is the one person who could know; the episode does not establish that he tore it, and the batch leaves that unresolved on purpose.

beats.what_happened: tirath comes drunk to the gate and demands four months' pay for Bhado, Kuar, Katik and Aghan; devlal says nothing stands against his name in the book and orders him removed; lakhan stops the men, and birju is made to say aloud that he is paid 4,200 a month against the 9,000 tirath started on.

state_changes.fact: his claim is publicly denied and he is publicly drunk
his salary is known to the whole shed and is less than half his predecessor's starting pay
has physically obstructed devlal in front of witnesses

beats.what_happened: dhaniram asks tirath where the page is that his claim was written on, gets no answer, tells the shed that tirath is not a thief whatever anybody has been saying, and sends him home.

state_changes.fact: an accusation he was never facing is spoken over him in public
has established in front of the shed that a claim without a page is only a man saying a number

beats.world_time: 2026-03-28, night, at the gate as tirath leaves
beats.location: teghra more, the road outside the gate
beats.what_happened: tirath presses a folded page into birju's hand, tells him not to open it anywhere dhaniram can hear paper, and says he will be at the crossing sober at eight.

state_changes.fact: is holding a document from outside the book he keeps
has made birju the only person who can act on what he knows

beats.what_happened: birju opens the page by lamp with lakhan and finds it ruled in the same columns as his own ledger, in a cleaner hand, numbered 411 at the top corner, while the book he was given begins at page one.

state_changes.fact: knows an earlier volume exists and that his book is not the beginning
is established as a continuation, not an original
